summary: Lincoln County, MT cabin with pole observation tower on Kootenai NF, built 1928 and abandoned 1942; the Association lists the tower as gone.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone; no source describes the summit today

access.note: No source we read describes access to the site

events.note: Cabin and pole observation tower, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: built 1928 as cabin with pole observation tower
coordinates 48.22757 north, 115.35026 west; listed as Tower, Gone

notes_for_editor: Dates (1928 built, 1942 abandoned) come from one firelookout.com line; the Association list supplies the Gone status. Rex's page has only the land location code and no history. Two searches turned up nothing on staffing, fires or the site today. Fisher Point (Granite County, a camp on the same list) is a different site and was not used. The story is short because the sources are.
